_comment: Isolates RL: the trained actor against its identical untrained warm start (same bot, resolver, opponent model, features and integer format; only the actor weights differ), plus an A/A copy of the candidate. Endpoint: equal-count mean paired utility difference meow_rl_large_v_s101 - meow_rl_warm_start over all 392 fixtures, 95% map-cluster interval (bots/p_only/tools/analyze.py), margin 0: an interval containing 0 is 'not shown'. A/A: score-vector agreement and its utility difference are diagnostics, not evidence of zero bias.
